key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between two readings of the sensors on the Overview page.

key.name: sensors-labels
key.description: Name the readings as the sensors command does, where the lm-sensors configuration gives a label.

key.name: hidden-readings
key.description: Readings not shown on the Overview page, as chip/channel@device, e.g. nct6687/fan2@devices/platform/nct6683.2592.

key.name: shown-readings
key.description: Readings that are off until turned on, such as the numbered temperature sensors of NVMe disks, and that are shown on the Overview page; as in the hidden readings.
